blocks.text:
An excursion to the Argentine side of the falls. Paths run among the cascades and bring you closer to the falling water. The surrounding natural park covers 55,500 hectares.

Within the park, you will take the train to the Devil’s Throat and then step onto a viewing platform above the falling water. Tickets are included in this programme. The services included in the standalone excursion may differ from those in the package tour.
